title: The debrief is where a simulation becomes learning
post: A simulation gives people shared experience. A careful debrief connects that experience with the decisions they face at work.

title: Make the contract review useful to both sides
post: What has changed for people using the service, and what decision follows? Five questions for a more useful contract review.

title: Give a learning programme a real piece of work
post: Choose a bounded piece of work, a sponsor who can act, and a way to review what changes. Making a development programme useful in practice.

title: Find the decision your partnership cannot currently make
post: Which shared decision keeps coming back without resolution? Use it to examine authority, evidence, and relationships across a partnership.

title: Commissioning starts with a question about purpose
post: Before writing the specification, ask what someone should be able to do, experience, or achieve. A PSTA practice note on commissioning and purpose.

title: Choose a development route around the work ahead
post: An individual learner, an organisational team, and a partnership need different kinds of development. Start by identifying who must learn and act together.

title: The National Commissioning Academy returns in November 2026
post: The National Commissioning Academy returns in November 2026. The next cohort combines anchor days, expert sessions, action learning, a national peer network, and a practical 100-day plan. Places are £2,490 excluding VAT, with discounts for group bookings and host organisations.
